name: Bingles' Blastencapper
label: Item
description: Bingles Blastenheimer’s explosive lies in trogg hands after his gyrocopter fell into the Loch. Its loss threatens his plans to aid Gnomeregan’s liberation.
intro: Bingles Blastenheimer’s explosive lies in trogg hands after his gyrocopter fell into the Loch. Its loss threatens his plans to aid Gnomeregan’s liberation.

p: Bingles Blastenheimer’s Blastencapper was aboard his gyrocopter when it crashed in Loch Modan. The pilot built the explosive for aerial strikes against the troggs and leper gnomes who overran Gnomeregan. Mechanical failure sent his craft into the Loch, though Bingles survived. Troggs from the lake’s northern islands raided the wreckage and carried the volatile weapon back to their camps.

Bingles needs the Blastencapper for the coming effort to retake Gnomeregan. The exiled gnomes are preparing to reclaim their radioactive home, and he counts on his gyrocopter and signature munitions for the air assault. The troggs of Loch Modan could accidentally trigger a catastrophe with the explosive, and its recovery would preserve a valuable weapon for the gnomish resistance.
